NATIONAL HEALTH AUTHORITY - GOVERNMENT OF INDIA
AYUSHMAN BHARAT - PRADHAN MANTRI JAN AROGYA YOJANA (AB PM-JAY)
1. SCHEME OVERVIEW
Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY is the world's largest health assurance scheme fully financed by the government. It aims to provide health cover of Rs. 5 lakhs per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
2. BENEFITS & FINANCIAL COVERAGE
A defined benefit cover of Rs. 5,00,000 per family per year on a family floater basis. It covers up to 3 days of pre-hospitalization and 15 days post-hospitalization expenses such as diagnostics and medicines. There is no restriction on family size, age or gender.

Ayushman_Bharat_PMJAY_Guidelines.pdf_p1_.text:
All pre-existing conditions are covered from day one.
3.
Ayushman_Bharat_PMJAY_Guidelines.pdf_p1_.scheme_name: AYUSHMAN BHARAT - PRADHAN MANTRI JAN AROGYA YOJANA (AB PM-JAY)

Ayushman_Bharat_PMJAY_Guidelines.pdf_p1_.text:
ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA
Beneficiary households are identified from the Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC 2011) database based on deprivation criteria:
- Rural: Families living in only one room with kucha walls/roof, female-headed households with no adult male member aged 16-59, disabled members, SC/ST households, landless households deriving major income from manual casual labor.
- Urban: 11 defined occupational categories (ragpickers, domestic workers, street vendors, construction workers, transport workers, etc.).
- Senior Citizens (70+ years): Comprehensive health coverage expanded for all citizens aged 70 years and above irrespective of income.
4.
Ayushman_Bharat_PMJAY_Guidelines.pdf_p1_.scheme_name: AYUSHMAN BHARAT - PRADHAN MANTRI JAN AROGYA YOJANA (AB PM-JAY)

Ayushman_Bharat_PMJAY_Guidelines.pdf_p1_.text:
REQUIRED DOCUMENTS & AYUSHMAN CARD
Aadhaar Card or Ration Card is required to verify identity. Once verified, the citizen receives the PVC Ayushman Card free of charge.
5. HOW TO AVAIL TREATMENT
Treatment is completely cashless and paperless at all empaneled public and private hospitals across India.
Citizens can check their eligibility at:
a) Official Portal: beneficiary.nha.gov.in or pmjay.gov.in
b) National Helpline: 14555
c) Ayushman Mitra kiosk at any empaneled hospital.

GOVERNMENT OF INDIA - MINISTRY OF AGRICULTURE AND FARMERS WELFARE
OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES: PRADHAN MANTRI KISAN SAMMAN NIDHI (PM-KISAN)
1. OBJECTIVE & SCHEME OVERVIEW
The Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) is a Central Sector Scheme to provide income support to all landholding farmer families in the country to supplement their financial needs for procuring various inputs related to agriculture and allied activities as well as domestic needs.
2. FINANCIAL BENEFITS
Under the Scheme, an income support of Rs. 6,000/- per year is provided to all eligible farmer families across the country in three equal installments of Rs. 2,000/- each, every four months.
PM_KISAN_Guidelines.pdf_p1_c1.scheme_name: OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES: PRADHAN MANTRI KISAN SAMMAN NIDHI (PM-KISAN)

PM_KISAN_Guidelines.pdf_p1_c2.text:
The amount is transferred directly into the bank accounts of the beneficiaries through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
3. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA
All landholding farmer families, who have cultivable landholding in their names, are eligible to get benefits under the scheme.
4.
PM_KISAN_Guidelines.pdf_p1_c2.scheme_name: OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES: PRADHAN MANTRI KISAN SAMMAN NIDHI (PM-KISAN)

PM_KISAN_Guidelines.pdf_p1_c3.text:
EXCLUSION CATEGORIES
The following categories of beneficiaries of higher economic status shall not be eligible:
a) All Institutional Landholders.
b) Former and present holders of constitutional posts.
c) Former and present Ministers, MPs, MLAs, MLCs, Mayors, and Chairpersons of District Panchayats.
d) All serving or retired officers and employees of Central/State Government Ministries and Departments.
e) All Persons who paid Income Tax in last assessment year.
f) Professionals like Doctors, Engineers, Lawyers, Chartered Accountants registered with professional bodies.
5. REQUIRED DOCUMENTS
Citizens applying require: 1. Aadhaar Card (mandatory), 2. Proof of citizenship, 3.
PM_KISAN_Guidelines.pdf_p1_c3.scheme_name: OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES: PRADHAN MANTRI KISAN SAMMAN NIDHI (PM-KISAN)

PM_KISAN_Guidelines.pdf_p1_c4.text:
Land ownership papers (Khatauni/Pattadar passbook), 4. Bank account details linked with Aadhaar, and 5. Active mobile number.
6. APPLICATION PROCEDURE
Farmers can apply through:
a) Official Portal: www.pmkisan.gov.in via 'New Farmer Registration'.
b) Common Service Centres (CSC) or Village Level MeeSeva / Grama Sachivalayam.
c) State Nodal Agriculture Officers designated by State Governments.
7. e-KYC MANDATORY REQUIREMENT
Aadhaar-based OTP verification on PM-KISAN portal or biometric e-KYC at CSC centers is compulsory for the release of subsequent installments.
